title: CLI daemon and realtime defaults: off by default for CLI, fire-and-forget publish, daemon socket timeouts
description: From kbs-bbf2a6. With default configuration (realtime.broker auto, autostart true) every mutation probes the broker, may spawn mosquitto and waits up to 16 s; the daemon adds spawn and wait time and has no socket timeouts. Default daemon and realtime auto-discovery off for CLI commands and on for the console; when a broker is explicitly configured (for example KANBUS_REALTIME_BROKER in ~/.kanbus.env, as on Ryan's machine with an always-on Mosquitto), the CLI must still publish, fire-and-forget on a detached thread with a hard cap, so live console updates keep working. Add timeouts to the daemon socket paths in both runtimes; stop the daemon terminating on per-connection I/O errors. Acceptance: kbs create on a board with mosquitto installed and no console running completes under 0.3 s with no spawned broker; with an explicit broker configured, the CLI still publishes the issue event.
